updates.note: Management stated international business is growing at an average of 21.4% in Q1 CY2026, keeping it above early teens.
updates.quote: Consolidated sales volumes grew by 16.3% in Q1 CY2026 driven by volume growth of 14.4% in India and 21.4% in international territories.

updates.note: International business including South Africa reported strong double-digit growth.
updates.quote: Average is 21% international. South Africa is very close to what the international market is growing.

new_promises.statement: Expect double-digit growth to continue for the next 5-10 years at least.
new_promises.quote: We are very bullish on the Indian market, and we believe the growth should continue in double-digits for the next 5-10 years at least.
new_promises.speaker: Ravi Jaipuria

new_promises.statement: CAPEX for India will be less than Rs. 500 crore to Rs. 600 crore this year.
new_promises.quote: Our CAPEX will be less than Rs. 500 crore - Rs. 600 crore this year for India.
new_promises.speaker: Ravi Jaipuria

new_promises.statement: Expand outlets by close to half a million this year.
new_promises.quote: Hopefully this year we might expand half a million outlets.
new_promises.speaker: Ravi Jaipuria
